idea-plugin.name: rr Record and Replay
idea-plugin.description:
Record a run with rr, replay it in CLion's normal debugger, and use reverse execution (reverse-continue, reverse-step, reverse-next, reverse-finish). Linux only.
Includes a perf_event_paranoid check with a one-click pkexec fix, a trace picker, and settings for the rr binary, trace directory and record flags.
